messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A low-slung quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing side view with a pale pink, broad and flat axolotl-like head and soft wrinkled body combined with a complete covering of large overlapping brown scales over its back and tail. The head has large dark eyes, a wide upturned mouth, and pink stalked feathery gills behind it. The pale pink underbody is transversely wrinkled and supported by four short thick legs with splayed clawed toes. A long tapering tail extends to the left, scaled on top and ringed pale skin below.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat pale pink with rounded snout, wide mouth line, and small nostril dots", "part": "head", "where": "at the front right of the body"}, {"looks_like": "large round black with pale blue rims", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "pink fleshy stalks with dense red feathery filaments, four on the near side and three visible on the far side", "part": "gills", "where": "just behind the head on both sides of the neck"}, {"looks_like": "short thick pale pink with wrinkled skin", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in back"}, {"looks_like": "splayed pale pink toes with small dark pointed claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "long tapering with overlapping scales on top and pale ringed skin underneath, narrowing to a point on the left", "part": "tail", "where": "extending to the rear left from the body"}, {"looks_like": "large overlapping rounded brown keratinous plates with lighter sheen", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the entire back from behind the head to the tip of the tail"}, {"looks_like": "pale pink soft with transverse wrinkles and folds", "part": "skin", "where": "on the head, sides, belly, legs and underside of tail"}, {"looks_like": "small dark speckles", "part": "markings", "where": "scattered on the top and sides of the head"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
